name: Denmark
contextBlurb: Denmark's stablecoin framework is MiCA-based. Fiat-backed stablecoins are permitted only through authorised EMT or ART issuers that satisfy reserve, redemption, white paper, governance and AML requirements. The Danish Financial Supervisory Authority supervises relevant crypto-asset activity under the EU framework.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU stablecoin rules for EMTs and ARTs, including authorisation, prudential requirements and investor protections.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Denmark follows MiCA. Stablecoin activity is legal with restrictions for authorised EMT and ART issuers, including reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML obligations.

regulators.name: Danish Financial Supervisory Authority
regulators.role: National financial supervisor for MiCA authorisation and oversight in Denmark.
